lines: SBIF PASS, the Para Athlete Sports Scholarship, supporting elite para-athletes across 8 Paralympic disciplines through monthly financial assistance, sports science based scientific development and a national pathway to the podium.
Equal opportunity for India's most determined athletes.
SBIF PASS, the Para Athlete Sports Scholarship
, to support para-athletes across 8 Paralympic sports disciplines.

The initiative offers financial assistance for training and competition while promoting inclusion, equal opportunity and helping athletes overcome barriers to achieve their full potential on the world stage.
Designed for elite training. Built for podium results.
Direct financial assistance designed to support training, equipment, physiotherapy, nutrition, travel and competitive excellence, so athletes can focus on one thing only performance.
Selection grounded in objective national and international ranking criteria.
Athlete profiling and assessments via Acrophase, the IIT Madras sports-science centre.
Structured support designed to accelerate athletes toward Paralympic-level competition.
A clear, transparent set of criteria, built to recognise both proven excellence and high-potential para-athletes.
Open to all Indian citizens, across 28+ states and UTs.
Must have represented India or your state at national or international level.
Rankings are evaluated on a points scale — World Rank 1–50, Asian Rank 1–10, and National Rank 1–20 all earn points. Higher rank, higher points.
Senior-category rankings will be considered for evaluation.
Applicants must be below the age of 35 as on the application date.
Must not be employed or already receiving another sports scholarship.
Only rankings published between 1 April 2024 and 30 July 2026 will be considered. The most recent ranking within this period applies.
In doubles or team events, the applicant must be an active and playing member of the team.
Applicants must belong to one of the 8 listed Paralympic sports disciplines below.
Phase II opens 80 scholarship slots across 8 Paralympic disciplines, with equal male–female representation in every sport.
* Scholars from Phase I will be accommodated within the available slots. Selection is based on demonstrated potential and sporting achievements.
Identity, contact details and demographic information.
Annual income and current employment status.
Passport photo, disability certificate and supporting uploads.
Competition history, event results and proof documents.
Applications open July 8, 2026 and close at midnight IST on August 9, 2026. Don't let your shot at the podium pass.

Acrophase is the sports science and technology group at IIT Madras — a Centre of Excellence for Human Performance Enhancement. For over 8 years, engineers, sports scientists and researchers from the Department of Electrical Engineering have built analytics platforms, performance testing systems and applied research programmes that bridge elite athletes, national federations and deep-tech innovation.
